description: KiCad hardware builds: schematic capture, PCB layout, enclosure co-design, and ERC/DRC/stackup sign-off instead of lint/typecheck/tests.

add.instructions: Design the schematic and layout per the plan (KiCad), trace geometry and stackup from first principles per godmode-hardware-pcb, and write production_artifacts/01_pcb_design.md plus the state.d fragment.

Optional: implement the firmware that runs on the board per the plan. Write production_artifacts/02_firmware_design.md and the state.d fragment. Skip and leave the artifact null when the plan says the build is hardware-only.

gates.erc: KiCad ERC runs with zero errors (the run_erc probe reports none)
gates.drc: KiCad DRC runs with zero errors (the run_drc probe reports none)
gates.constraints: Stackup, netclass and impedance constraints check out against the pcb-constraint rules the plan states

selection.description: Pick when the goal is a hardware/PCB build: schematics, layout, gerbers, ERC/DRC sign-off.

notes: agentType godmode-engineering is used because no hardware-specific compiled agent exists yet; the domain behavior comes from the godmode-hardware-pcb skill allowlist. Firmware is the optional second build node per the analysis (skip when the goal is hardware-only).
